items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Master's degree

Must have a minimum of 3 years of combined experience with eLearning authoring tools (such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, etc.), video production software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, Camtasia, Final Cut Pro, etc.), and/or animated video creators.
Technical experience with web content management systems and graphical design.
6 - 10 years of related experience.
Minimum of 6 years of combined experience facilitating, managing educational programs, and implementing instructor-led training.

Oversees communications, outreach, and marketing efforts that are wide ranging and comprehensive, including (but not limited to): print, web, email, video, oral presentations, slide presentations, webinars, and emerging technologies. Provides divisional strategic messaging, planning, and implementation of projects in support of the University's risk, health, and safety programs. Advises and guides to ensure consistent and standardized branding / imaging. Manages divisional websites, and uses expert graphical design skills. Responsible for event management in the division. (20% time)

May assume responsibility for specific training programs, initiatives and budget. Implements staff, faculty, and student training using instructional design and program management skills. Facilitates and provides education during instructor-led training activities. Develops online and in-person training courses using adult learning and instructional design. Creates presentations, handouts, eLearning, webinars, and oversees the production of course content according to an established schedule. Builds with accessibility in mind. Supports instructor-led training activities including management of rosters, supplies & equipment, registration, event management, and evaluations. Simultaneously tracks multiple complex projects, processes shifting priorities, and executes decisions with high accuracy in time-sensitive scenarios. Synthesizes actionable strategies in high-stakes, time-sensitive scenarios. (15% time)

Initiates and designs highly complex training studies and needs analysis to ensure effectiveness of current and new training initiatives. Collaborates across departments to conduct needs assessment(s), develop, and implement training plans / assignments in the University learning management system. Designs University-wide risk and safety training initiatives. Assesses, delivers, and evaluates all related training requirements based on broad and complex regulatory and best practices. (15% time)

Works collaboratively and effectively in a diverse environment with others across the organization, important external contacts, and members of organization management at all levels to resolve highly complex performance and /or training issues, where analysis of situations requires an in-depth evaluation and understanding of organization strategies and business objectives. Collaborates with senior leaders to ensure that training methods are appropriate and meet the division's goals, metrics, and strategic objectives (15% time)

Using project and program management practices, may lead an enterprise or systemwide program or project. Actively participates as a member or advisor on University committees in a systemwide, campuswide, and/or interdisciplinary capacity. (10% time)

May serve as leader for professional project team members. Serves as Train-the-Trainer. Prepares and guides subject matter experts (SMEs) for instruction using adult learning and instructional design principles. Evaluates and ensures process improvement. Mentors staff and promotes professional growth and advancement. (10% time)

Provides support to improve teaching and learning outcomes. Supports administration, information technology, and web content management needs of the division. Provides functional support for operations and special projects. Uses high-level software and technology to assess needs, collect and manage data, and forecast / plan for budgetary requirements. Designs, implements, maintains, and supports webpages and applications. (10% time)

Implements related business processes such as: preparing and managing metrics and reports, purchase orders, travel arrangements, calendars, and webpages. May also serve as member of the emergency and/or Incident Response Team, as needed. Complies with policies and procedures. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Frequently
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly

Other: Frequently required to learn quickly, process information, make rapid decisions (with positive outcomes), and solve complex problems under pressure. Constantly must comprehend new technologies, regulatory frameworks, and operational models with minimal supervision.
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Advanced knowledge of training and development, performance management and workplace learning. Ability to apply knowledge to achieve successful organizational outcomes.
Advanced knowledge of training and delivery methodologies, organizational diagnosis and organization and business strategies.
Advanced verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills and advanced presentation skills.
Advanced analytical skills to conduct analysis and develop recommendations, demonstrating organization and problem-solving skills.
Advanced knowledge and skills with relevant software systems and content creation tools.
Advanced knowledge of organizational policies and procedures.
Familiarity with website content management systems, such as Drupal.
Advanced knowledge of functional area and advanced understanding of how work impacts other areas in human resources and the organization.
Advanced skills in planning, resourcing and monitoring effective training delivery.
